timeline.timingHelp: Offset delays this layer. Trim chooses its local keyframe range; speed remaps time; repeat loops that range. Dimmed diamonds are outside the trim.
timeline.keyframeHelp: Each diamond stores position, scale, opacity and rotation. Its curve controls only the following segment.

recipe.title: Recipe runner
recipe.manualHelp: Add plates and GLBs with previews, then ask the LLM to compose. Edit the scene, then Record.
recipe.autoHelp: Describe the scene normally. HocusPocus plans reusable 3D subjects, plates, camera and effects; review the plan before generation.
recipe.howBody: Mention subjects that must keep their identity, actions in order, the setting, and optionally camera, duration or format. Moving characters, vehicles and objects become separate reusable 3D assets; a fixed environment becomes one plate; fog, snow and rain become effects.

hunyuan.title: Hunyuan3D Studio
hunyuan.subtitle: Native geometry, multi-view reconstruction and PBR materials.
hunyuan.subtitleRemote: Remote image/text to 3D. Change the default in Settings → Integrations.
hunyuan.installHint: Stop HocusPocus and run its standard Install or Update action. The runtime stays inside HocusPocus; model weights download on first use.
hunyuan.sourceGlbHelp: The original is never overwritten. Hunyuan creates a new static textured copy.
hunyuan.chooseOrImport: Choose a gallery GLB or import one.
hunyuan.retextureHelp: Animated/rigged GLBs are intentionally rejected because Hunyuan Paint rebuilds UVs. Retexture the static base first, then rig its new copy.
hunyuan.promptRetexture: Describe the new texture or use an image
hunyuan.placeholderRetexture: Example: worn red painted steel with scratched edges and dark panels…
hunyuan.placeholderGenerate: Describe a single object, or upload a reference below...
hunyuan.pickerHelp: Newest 200 images in the active workspace.
hunyuan.noImages: No images in this HocusPocus workspace yet.
hunyuan.compileTitle: First compile can pin RAM for a long time. Leave off unless you know you need it.
hunyuan.advancedHelp: Higher octree/texture resolutions and PBR consume substantially more VRAM. Chunks above 16k at octree 512 can freeze the GPU. CPU offload is recommended while other HocusPocus models are in use.
hunyuan.firstUse: First use downloads only the selected checkpoint. The isolated worker exits after export.
hunyuan.glbOnly: Retexturing currently accepts GLB files only.
hunyuan.jobLost: The 3D job was lost — the backend probably restarted.

rig.title: Rig & Animate
rig.subtitle: Give a generated 3D object a simple skeleton and looping animations. The result is saved as a new GLB in the gallery.
rig.connectionHelp: HocusPocus's backend did not answer — it may be stopped or restarting. The procedural engine needs no extra install; this is a connection issue, not a missing installation.
rig.noGlbs: No GLB outputs yet. Generate an object in the 3D tab first.
rig.proceduralHelp: Applies a tailored chain fit and shows only compatible motion clips. You can fine-tune the fit below.
rig.unirigHelp: Filters the motion library for this body type. UniRig still predicts its own skeleton and skin weights.
rig.previewsHelp: These previews visualize HocusPocus's generic procedural chain and its intended root motion, squash, turn and sway. They do not claim semantic limb animation.
rig.manualFitHelp: Guide the procedural bone chain before generating. This adjusts the rig fit without pretending to be a full weight-painting editor.
rig.stiffnessHelp: Low bends smoothly; high keeps sections more rigid. Useful for characters versus hard-surface props.
rig.exportHelp: Downloads the rigged model with its baked clips. It also remains available in HocusPocus's 3D gallery.
rig.unirigFooter: AI rigging uses the GPU; the first run downloads the UniRig weights (~2GB).
rig.proceduralFooter: Runs on CPU in seconds. The animated GLB plays its clips in the gallery viewer.

descriptions.smoke: Soft plumes that rise and disperse with the wind.
descriptions.ash: Irregular grey fallout for burned or volcanic scenes.
descriptions.fireflies: Warm wandering lights with organic pulsing.
descriptions.bokeh: Large dreamy lights with a slow cinematic drift.
descriptions.sparkles: Twinkling four-point stars for magical reveals.
descriptions.bubbles: Outlined bubbles rising through underwater shots.
descriptions.speedlines: Fast directional streaks for action and impacts.
descriptions.leaves: Rotating autumn leaves with varied warm colours.

animator.canvasHelp: Center-drag a 3D layer to orbit it 360°; drag its outer edge to move it. Camera layers animate pan, zoom and rotation without rendering an asset. Parallax controls how strongly each visual layer follows camera pan. WebM uses the same camera transform and Z order as this preview.
animator.loopReadyHelp: I reviewed this plate in Fondo infinito (or it is a verified panorama). This enables the cylinder A/B preview; it does not claim the model repaired the seam mathematically.
animator.instructSceneHelp: Ask for a restrained global camera move, visual mood, or an explicit link between existing layers. Links always require confirmation; it cannot add, remove, move, or replace assets.
animator.instructScenePlaceholder: Make the camera drift slowly and give the whole scene a cool, dreamy tone…
animator.sceneAudioHelp: Generate narration with the installed audio model, or attach an existing audio output. Prompt, model, start time and volume stay with the scene and its exported metadata.
animator.sceneAudioPlaceholder: A calm inner voice: ‘I know this place…’
animator.rhythmHelp: The detected grid is offset with the track, then baked into normal keyframes shared by preview and MP4 export. “Peek” hides the selected object between beats and reveals it on each hit.
animator.cutoutHelp: With mouth overlays named Open, Small, Wide, Round and optionally Closed, turn a known line into a restrained speaking rhythm. Missing shapes safely fall back to Open.
animator.bindFace: Bind face overlays to selected pose
animator.speaker: Speaker
animator.chainHelp: Starts on frame {{frame}} from the exact current transform.
animator.unlockHelp: Unlock this layer to change transforms, timing, presets or keyframes.
animator.name: Name
animator.shakeHelp: Shake is opt-in. Photo motion presets are smooth by default; camera shots marked “shake” enable it deliberately.
animator.cameraHelp: The highest visible camera is active. Its pan, zoom and rotation are applied identically to preview and WebM capture.
animator.infiniteBackground: Create infinite background from selected image
animator.cylinderLocked: Cylinder A/B is locked until this plate is marked loop-ready when mounting a narrative scene. Use Fondo infinito first; flat parallax remains the safe renderer.
animator.instructLayerHelp: Describe a change for this selected layer. The copilot proposes a reversible scene edit; it cannot alter other layers.
animator.instructLayerPlaceholder: Move it left and make it look thoughtful…
animator.photoMotionHelp: Prepares this photograph as a full-frame background and creates or updates the active camera. Hover a card to preview the move on your photo.
animator.hoverPreview: Hover to preview · click again to remove
animator.clipSamplerHelp: Scrub, preview and WebM use the same paused-frame sampler.
animator.selectLayer: Select a layer to edit it.
animator.particlesHelp: Particles are deterministic: scrubbing, playback and recording show the same frame. Use layer opacity and Z to blend the effect into the shot.
animator.parallaxHelp: 0 ignores camera pan, 1 follows it normally, and values above 1 feel closer. Zoom and camera roll still affect the full shot. Background adds 20% overscan to image/video layers; extreme moves may need more scale.
animator.effectsHelp: Percent effects scale from the frame’s short side, so preview, saved thumbnail and WebM stay visually aligned. Effects are clipped to the layer box or selected mask.
animator.stripHelp: Repeats this layer in a seamless moving row or column. It works with transparent 2D assets, video and GLB.
animator.seamHelp: A foreground silhouette stays locked to each tile join so a looping plate never shows its seam.
animator.glbCap: Preview caps GLB copies at 4. Extra copies freeze the GPU.
animator.parentHelp: Inherits the target movement, scale and rotation while preserving this layer’s own animation.
animator.followHelp: Blends toward the target plus the stored offset. Camera follow keeps the subject framed.
animator.lookAtHelp: Rotates this layer so it faces the target in the current output aspect ratio.
animator.orbitHelp: The cyan cross marks the exact orbit center. Use center offsets when an asymmetric GLB's visual center differs from its layer box. Negative turns reverse direction.
animator.suggestionCamera1: Keep the camera restrained for the whole shot
animator.suggestionCamera2: Add a very gentle drift without zooming
animator.suggestionThought1: Move it left and make it look thoughtful
animator.suggestionThought2: Leave space for an inner voice on the right
animator.suggestionRun1: Keep the subject stable and add a subtle run-like bob
animator.suggestionRun2: Make this foreground layer move faster than the world
animator.suggestionModel1: Turn it slightly to camera right
animator.suggestionModel2: Give it a gentle living drift
animator.suggestionDefault2: Make its look calmer and more cinematic
